description_en: Adds a data source to an attached multicloud account
description_zh: 在该绑定的多云账号下添加数据源
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem add-data-source --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

obs: Huawei Cloud Object Storage Service (OBS).

wafApi: Tencent Cloud Web Application Firewall (WAF) download API.

ckafka: Tencent Cloud CKafka
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型。取值：
obs：华为云obs。
wafApi：腾讯云waf下载api。 
ckafka： 腾讯云ckafka
parameters.name: data_source_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The remarks on the data source
parameters.name: data_source_instance_remark

parameters.help_en: The parameters for the data source. The value must be a JSON array
parameters.name: data_source_instance_params

parameters.help_en: The code for the multicloud service
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: For assets in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: For assets in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Count.description_en: The number of data sources that were added. A value of 1 indicates success. A value of 0 or less indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 添加数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。

DataSourceInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the data source. The threat analysis feature generates the ID by calculating an MD5 hash of the parameter values
DataSourceInstanceId.description_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成
DataSourceInstanceId.title_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。
